name: Mailchimp Content Optimizer
statusNote: Content Optimizer is an AI feature of Mailchimp, on mailchimp.com/solutions/ai-tools/. See mailchimp.
summary: Mailchimp Content Optimizer uses AI to analyze marketing emails, providing personalized recommendations for subject lines, copy, and design. It helps marketers improve open and click rates.
description:
Mailchimp Content Optimizer uses AI to analyze marketing emails, providing personalized recommendations for subject lines, copy, and design. It helps marketers improve open and click rates.

Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence turns your data into clear answers and a recommended next move — Analytics AI, plus ChatGPT and Claude connectors.

AI analysis of subject lines and body copy. Actionable suggestions for engagement. Design optimization tools. Personalized recommendations for content.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: AI analysis of subject lines and body copy.

howToUse.title: Sign Up or Log In
howToUse.description: Create or log in to your Mailchimp account. Access the Content Optimizer tool from your dashboard.

howToUse.title: Analyze an Email Campaign
howToUse.description: Select or create a marketing email, then run the Content Optimizer to analyze subject lines, copy, and design.

howToUse.title: Review AI Recommendations
howToUse.description: Follow actionable AI suggestions for subject lines, email body, and visual layout to improve performance.

howToUse.title: Implement Changes
howToUse.description: Edit your email campaign according to the recommendations for maximum engagement and click rates.

howToUse.title: Track Performance
howToUse.description: Monitor open and click rates post-send, and use ongoing optimization for future campaigns.
